name: Porphyritic-Fjard
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, dust seas stretching to the horizon. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
